heroSubtitle: An all-in-one digital ERP for contractors: Bills of Quantities (BOQ), owner & subcontractor progress payment certificates, project costing, and milestone tracking.
heroBoxDesc: Automatic retention, down-payment recovery, and statutory tax calculations.
visionTitle: Master Profit Margins and Cost Controls Across Job Sites
visionDesc: Contracting requires stringent supervision of material wastage, heavy equipment utilization, and subcontractor claims. USoft gives you immediate visibility into estimated vs. actual expenses per item.

features.title: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) & Estimations
features.desc: Break down tender estimates into granular line items with standard costs for materials, labor, machinery, and subcontracts, benchmarked against real site expenses.

features.title: Owner & Subcontractor Progress Invoices
features.desc: Generate milestone payment certificates reflecting cumulative progress percentages, advance payment amortization, performance retentions, and delay penalties.

features.title: Subcontractor Agreement Governance
features.desc: Document subcontractor contracts with itemized rates and auto-generate payment vouchers while deducting company-supplied materials and retention buffers.

features.title: Site Cost Centers & Expense Tracking
features.desc: Tie material issues, machine hours, and daily labor logs directly to relevant project WBS elements for real-time project profitability.

features.title: Heavy Equipment & Plant Management
features.desc: Track operating hours for owned and rented machinery, fuel logs, maintenance schedules, and allocate equipment depreciation directly across jobs.

features.title: Bank Guarantees & Letters of Credit (LG/LC)
features.desc: Track bid bonds, performance bonds, and advance payment guarantees with expiration alerts, renewals, and related banking fees.

steps.title: Tender Study & BOQ Structuring
steps.desc: Input project line items, unit cost benchmarks, profit margins, and produce formal tender bids.

steps.title: Contracting & Subcontractor Allotment
steps.desc: Formalize client agreements, award packages to subcontractors, and initialize project cost centers.

steps.title: Site Execution & Direct Cost Tracking
steps.desc: Issue raw materials, track equipment hour meters and labor timesheets against budgeted ceilings.

steps.title: Progress Billing & Handover
steps.desc: Issue certified progress certificates to the owner, settle subcontractor dues, and close project retention.
